package.description: like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane, without Tailscale's control plane

en-US.description: like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane, without Tailscale's control plane
en-US.longDescription: Tailcat is a remix of Tailscale open source pieces to act like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane, without Tailscale's control plane. Tailscale's data plane (magicsock, internally) gives you point-to-point WireGuard®-encrypted tunnels between two machines with DERP as the NAT-hole-punching communication side channel and the ultimate relay-of-last-resort if NAT traversal fails. Instead of using the Tailscale control plane, all tailcat connection metadata is exchanged out of band, however you want.
en-US.name: tailcat
